# Department of Energy
> The official website of the U.S. Department of Energy, covering energy policy, national security, scientific research, infrastructure, and public programs.

Energy.gov is the primary public information hub for the U.S. Department of Energy and its offices, laboratories, and mission areas. It provides access to DOE leadership, topical programs, emergency and cybersecurity resources, scientific initiatives, education programs, and links to major affiliated organizations such as NNSA, EIA, OSTI, and the national laboratories.

## Department Overview
- [Department of Energy](https://www.energy.gov/): DOE homepage with agency news, mission areas, and featured programs.
- [History](https://www.energy.gov/lm/history): Historical background on the Department of Energy and predecessor agencies.
- [Our Leadership & Offices](https://www.energy.gov/our-leadership-offices): DOE leadership, offices, and organizational structure overview.
- [Newsroom](https://www.energy.gov/newsroom): Official DOE news releases, announcements, and media updates.
- [Digital Engagement and Media](https://www.energy.gov/digital-engagement-and-media): DOE digital communications, media resources, and public engagement information.
- [Brand Guides](https://www.energy.gov/design): DOE design standards, branding guidance, and visual identity resources.

## National Security & Emergency Response
- [Nuclear Security](https://www.energy.gov/topics/nuclear-security): DOE nuclear security programs, deterrence, and nonproliferation-related information.
- [National Nuclear Security Administration](https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/national-nuclear-security-administration): NNSA overview covering nuclear security, stockpile stewardship, and nonproliferation missions.
- [Energy Security](https://www.energy.gov/topics/energy-security): DOE efforts to strengthen energy infrastructure security and resilience.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.energy.gov/topics/cybersecurity): DOE cybersecurity initiatives for the energy sector and critical infrastructure.
- [Emergency Response Hub](https://www.energy.gov/ceser/emergency-response-hub-0): Emergency response information for energy disruptions and incident coordination.
- [Research, Technology, & Economic Security](https://www.energy.gov/topics/research-technology-and-economic-security): DOE policies and programs addressing research security and economic resilience.

## Science, Research & Innovation
- [Earth Systems Modeling](https://www.energy.gov/topics/earth-systems-modeling): DOE climate and Earth system modeling research programs and resources.
- [Department of Energy Nobel Laureates](https://www.energy.gov/science/department-energy-nobel-laureates): DOE-affiliated Nobel Prize winners in science and research.
- [Scientific Research Database (OSTI)](https://www.osti.gov/): DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information research publications and records.
- [U.S. Department of Energy National Laboratories](https://www.energy.gov/us-department-energy-national-laboratories): Directory and overview of DOE’s national laboratory system.
- [Genesis Mission](https://genesis.energy.gov/): DOE initiative focused on advancing next-generation energy and innovation priorities.

## Data, Analysis & Information Resources
- [U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)](https://www.energy.gov/us-energy-information-administration-eia): DOE gateway to federal energy statistics, analysis, and forecasts.
- [Energy Information Administration](https://www.eia.gov/): Official EIA site for U.S. energy data, reports, and market analysis.
- [OSTI.GOV](https://www.osti.gov/): Search portal for DOE-funded scientific and technical research outputs.
- [Newsroom](https://www.energy.gov/newsroom): Current DOE announcements, statements, and press materials.
- [Digital Engagement and Media](https://www.energy.gov/digital-engagement-and-media): Public-facing media channels and communication resources.

## Laboratories, Power Systems & Infrastructure
- [U.S. Department of Energy National Laboratories](https://www.energy.gov/us-department-energy-national-laboratories): Overview of DOE laboratories supporting science, energy, and security missions.
- [Power Marketing Administrations](https://www.energy.gov/power-marketing-administrations): Information on federal power marketing and hydroelectric transmission entities.
- [Energy Security](https://www.energy.gov/topics/energy-security): Programs supporting grid reliability, fuel security, and infrastructure resilience.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.energy.gov/topics/cybersecurity): Energy-sector cyber defense and infrastructure protection resources.
- [Emergency Response Hub](https://www.energy.gov/ceser/emergency-response-hub-0): DOE emergency coordination resources for energy infrastructure incidents.

## Environmental Management
- [Environmental & Legacy Management](https://www.energy.gov/topics/environmental-and-legacy-management): DOE environmental cleanup, waste management, and legacy site information.
- [History](https://www.energy.gov/lm/history): Historical context for DOE legacy missions and environmental responsibilities.
- [Our Leadership & Offices](https://www.energy.gov/our-leadership-offices): DOE offices responsible for environmental and operational mission areas.

## Education & Public Programs
- [National Science Bowl](https://www.energy.gov/topics/national-science-bowl): DOE academic competition program for middle and high school students.
- [Department of Energy Nobel Laureates](https://www.energy.gov/science/department-energy-nobel-laureates): Educational overview of DOE-connected Nobel Prize achievements.
- [Earth Systems Modeling](https://www.energy.gov/topics/earth-systems-modeling): Public information on DOE-supported climate science and modeling.
- [Digital Engagement and Media](https://www.energy.gov/digital-engagement-and-media): Public outreach channels and DOE engagement platforms.

## Media, Design & Communications
- [Newsroom](https://www.energy.gov/newsroom): Central source for DOE press releases and official announcements.
- [Digital Engagement and Media](https://www.energy.gov/digital-engagement-and-media): Media operations, digital strategy, and public communications resources.
- [Brand Guides](https://www.energy.gov/design): Official DOE branding, logo, and design guidance.
- [Department of Energy](https://www.energy.gov/): Main portal for agency updates, campaigns, and featured content.

## Affiliated Agencies & External Resources
- [National Nuclear Security Administration](https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/national-nuclear-security-administration): DOE semiautonomous agency responsible for nuclear security missions.
- [Energy Information Administration](https://www.energy.gov/us-energy-information-administration-eia): DOE page introducing the federal energy statistics agency.
- [Energy Information Administration](https://www.eia.gov/): Independent statistical and analytical agency for U.S. energy information.
- [Scientific Research Database (OSTI)](https://www.osti.gov/): DOE scientific and technical information repository.
- [Genesis Mission](https://genesis.energy.gov/): DOE initiative site for mission-focused innovation and engagement.
